def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    allowed = lambda owner: actor["authenticated"]
    return row if row is not None and allowed(row["owner_id"]) else None
cases.threat_model: records and the authenticated actor session are trusted. record_id is attacker-controlled. Only the owner may read a record. Login and tenant membership alone do not permit reading another owner's record. Missing records return None.
